answer_1.quote: We investigate whether an instance-level captioning model can be extended to generate coherent and informative descriptions for groups of visual instances...

answer_2.quote: We use two standard overlap metrics, BLEU and CIDEr, to assess the similarity of generated group descriptions with reference sentence groups...

answer_4.quote: We performed human evaluation on the most promising LSTM and Transformer speaker models using the Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT) crowdsourcing platform... We asked them to select the description(s) that best describe all or most of the images in the group in a forced-choice task with 3 options (A, B, or both).
answer_4.guideline: Participants were shown all images of the target group and two competing descriptions (group description and instance description) and asked to choose which description best describes all or most images (option A, B, or both).
